scheme_name: Multi State Cooperative Societies Development Fund
overview: The Multi State Cooperative Societies Development Fund is a financial assistance scheme aimed at supporting the development and strengthening of multi-state cooperative societies in India. It provides financial support for various developmental activities including infrastructure, technology upgradation, and human resource development. The fund is managed by the National Cooperative Development Corporation (NCDC) under the Ministry of Cooperation. The scheme aims to enhance the economic viability and operational efficiency of multi-state cooperatives across the country.
objectives: To provide financial assistance for the development of multi-state cooperative societies
To support infrastructure development and modernization of cooperative enterprises
To promote technology upgradation and adoption of best practices in cooperatives
To enhance human resource development and training within cooperative societies
To strengthen the financial base and economic viability of multi-state cooperatives
To encourage diversification and expansion of cooperative business activities
To support risk management and institutional building initiatives
To promote inclusive growth and equitable development through cooperative models
eligibility: Multi-state cooperative societies registered under the Multi-State Cooperative Societies Act, 2002 are eligible to apply for financial assistance under the fund. The societies must demonstrate viable project proposals with clear developmental objectives and repayment capacity. Preference may be given to societies working in priority sectors such as agriculture, dairy, fisheries, handicrafts, and rural industries.
benefits: Financial assistance in the form of term loans and working capital support at concessional interest rates. Support for infrastructure development including construction of godowns, processing units, and retail outlets. Assistance for technology upgradation, automation, and adoption of modern management practices. Funding for human resource development, training programs, and capacity building initiatives. Support for working capital requirements to meet operational needs. Technical guidance and project formulation assistance from NCDC. Flexible repayment terms tailored to the cash flow patterns of cooperative enterprises.
financial_support: The fund provides term loans and working capital assistance to eligible multi-state cooperative societies. The quantum of financial support is determined based on the viability and scale of the proposed project, subject to the availability of funds and adherence to NCDC's lending norms. Assistance is typically extended as a loan with concessional interest rates and flexible repayment schedules. The exact terms including interest rate, moratorium period, and repayment duration are assessed on a case-to-case basis by the National Cooperative Development Corporation.
application_process: 1. Identify a viable project proposal aligned with the developmental objectives of the fund. 2. Prepare a detailed project report including technical, financial, and economic feasibility analysis. 3. Submit the application along with required documents to the National Cooperative Development Corporation (NCDC). 4. NCDC undertakes preliminary scrutiny and field verification of the proposal. 5. The proposal is evaluated by the competent authority within NCDC for approval. 6. Upon approval, a sanction letter is issued outlining the terms and conditions of financial assistance. 7. Loan documentation is executed and disbursement is made in stages as per project progress. 8. Post-disbursement monitoring is conducted to ensure proper utilization of funds.
required_documents: Certificate of Registration under Multi-State Cooperative Societies Act, 2002
Memorandum of Association and Bye-laws of the society
Audited financial statements for the last 3 years
Detailed project report with technical and financial feasibility
Land documents or lease agreement for project site (if applicable)
Cost estimates and quotations for major equipment and civil works
Resolution of the Board of Directors approving the project and loan application
No Objection Certificate from concerned regulatory authorities (if required)
Promoter contribution details and means of finance
deadlines: Rolling basis — applications are accepted throughout the year subject to availability of funds.
implementing_agency: National Cooperative Development Corporation (NCDC), Ministry of Cooperation
caveats: Financial assistance is subject to the availability of funds under the scheme
Priority may be given to projects in identified thrust sectors and underserved regions
Beneficiary societies must contribute a minimum promoter's equity as per NCDC norms
Utilization of funds must be strictly for the approved project purpose
Regular monitoring and reporting are mandatory during and after project implementation
The fund does not provide grants; assistance is extended on a repayable basis
Societies with outstanding dues to NCDC or other government agencies may be ineligible
